title: Извинения перед шейхом  (Apologies to the Sheikh)

segments.t: When the sheikh demands an explanation for the commotion in his suite, Max explains that the interpreter has been using His Highness's name to seduce the waitresses. The sheikh fires the interpreter on the spot.
Он использует ваше имя в своих целях.
Сказал, что если мы не извинимся, то нас уволят.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'What is happening here?' The guest probes eagerly if there is more going on behind the scenes.
'Excuse us, please.' Max directly speaks this polite apology at this moment using "izvinite" ("excuse me") — the respectful form of "excuse me" or "sorry" used when stepping in or apologizing.
'It is your interpreter's fault.' Bringing up the interpreter during the talk, Max links the Russian words directly in the present with no word for "am", "is", or "are" needed.
Он использует ваше имя в своих целях.
'He is using your name for his own purposes.' Max pushes back openly around the guest, leaving no doubt about where he stands.
'I beg your pardon, he will be fired.' Pointing to the forgiveness in this beat, the guest chooses "proshcheniya" ("forgiveness", from the root "proshcheniye") so Max hears the exact meaning.
'What did he just say?' Reacting firmly right here, Senya puts the question word "chto" right at the start so the guest hears the focus immediately.
Сказал, что если мы не извинимся, то нас уволят.
'He said that if we do not apologize, we will be fired.' The guest answers steadily with a nod, testing Senya's reaction in the middle of the exchange.

'Excuse us, please!' Senya plainly voices this polite apology in front of the guest using "izvinite" ("excuse me") — the respectful form of "excuse me" or "sorry" used when stepping in or apologizing.

'Excuse us, guys, we are leaving already.' Max casually chooses this polite apology in one quick breath using "izvinite" ("excuse me") — the respectful form of "excuse me" or "sorry" used when stepping in or apologizing.
'This will never happen again!' Senya weighs in calmly with a smile, grounding the moment in plain reality.
'You may return to work.' Addressing the work during the talk, the guest uses "vozvrashchatsya" ("to return") to carry the main weight of the thought.
'Let us get out of here to the kitchen quickly.' Underscoring the kitchen at once, Max brings in "kukhnyu" ("kitchen", from "kukhnya") as the key Russian word here.
Он использует ваше имя в своих целях.
Сказал, что если мы не извинимся, то нас уволят.
With the interpreter exposed and the sheikh appeased, the staff hurry back downstairs to the restaurant. See you next time!
